segments.sensitive: A reviewer with sensitive skin says the patches are gentle and still work well, and another notes they don't leave skin red or sensitized after use.
segments.mature: One reviewer reports pimples returning after menopause and says the patches, checked safe for her fragrance allergy with an allergen app, cleared most overnight though a couple of cystic ones took longer.

concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report the patches flatten whiteheads and cystic or under-skin pimples within one to two nights, several calling it more effective than other brands; a minority say it did not work for them, took about a week, or was not effective on deep painful pimples.
concerns.spots: One reviewer credits the patches with letting her avoid squeezing a pimple and the resulting scarring, while another reports still being left with visible scarring after a large pimple cleared.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers note reduced redness around treated blemishes and say the patches don't leave skin red afterward, though one describes slight residual redness right after removing a patch.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer highlights that the patches treat blemishes without damaging the skin barrier.

These patches are alright if you're looking for something inexpensive. They remove a lot of gunk during the day or night, but the pimple doesn't actually go away in my experience. They also leave a sticky residue on my skin when I peel them off.

extraits.titre: Where were these when I was a teen?
extraits.texte: Suddenly after menopause I'm getting both juicy and painful pimples again. They do not do well with popping so I set out for a solution. Because I have a balsam of Peru allergy, many health and beauty products are a no go for me. I use an app called SkinSafe that tells me whether or not they are OK. My app told me this one was fine, so I got it. Having these tiny stickers all over my face did not make me think that my pimples would be gone in the morning, but I was amazed. It doesn't heal the skin immediately, but almost every one of the patches had the icky filling on them when I peeled it off this morning I do have a couple of cystic ones that I think is going to take a couple more nights to drain, but I have hopes. My face looks and feels much better this morning.

These pimple patches have by far been my favorite that I have used. I have gone through so many different ones, and Good Molecules are the ones that I have stuck with. They are so gentle on my sensitive skin and work so well. I love that they come in packs of 15 and 60 patches in one pack is awesome because I go through them so quickly. So excited I get to use such a great product!

Pimple patches are the perfect spot treatment you can trust to not damage your skin barrier. These are a great option because of the invisible look while wearing them without sacrificing any functionality. Paying for pimple patches can quickly add up but these are a great quantity for price. They are also the perfect gift that anyone can get excited about.

Highly recommend if you're looking to start unclogging pores.
